title: Customer status digest and RCA tracking for intermittent KV cache throttling
creator: Aisha Gupta
description: Goal: produce a concise, customer-facing incident digest and internal RCA tracker for the intermittent KV cache throttling incidents observed 2026-02-20 through 2026-02-24. Deliverables: 1) public status-page update drafts for three customer tiers (trial, self-serve, enterprise), 2) a time-ordered internal timeline of events with ownership and evidence links, 3) a prioritized action list with owners and ETA (short/medium/long-term), 4) follow-up monitoring alerts and dashboard panels to detect recurrence, 5) guidance for account teams on customer outreach cadence. Scope: incidents caused by unexpected KV cache eviction behavior under bursty prefix reuse; includes rollback and patch rollout communications but excludes billing/credits policy decisions (handled by Growth/CS).
status_page_updates: 2026-02-21 14:12 UTC: Initial degraded performance notice posted. Message: "We are investigating increased latency for some text-generation requests in certain regions. No data loss."

2026-02-22 09:30 UTC: Follow-up: Identified risk window and mitigations. Message: "We have identified cache eviction pressure as likely contributor and are applying conservative backoffs to reduce contention. Enterprise customers will be notified directly with suggested mitigations."

2026-02-24 17:00 UTC: Resolution/Update: Message: "We rolled out throttle tuning and a fix for aggressive eviction; overall performance stabilized. A detailed RCA and customer digest will be published by 2026-03-12."
comments: 2026-02-25 - Aisha: Created ticket after post-incident sync. Primary goals: public digest + internal action register. Assigned to Liam for coordination with Customer Success and Docs.

2026-02-26 - Liam: Short triage completed. Root cause hypothesis: race in cache admission code that, under specific workload shapes (many short contexts with high prefix reuse), caused mass eviction and CPU spikes on shard hosts. Mitigation applied: adjusted admission backoff and raised per-shard memory watermark. Observed 40-60% reduction in eviction rate on canary hosts.

2026-02-27 - Priya (SRE): Instrumentation gap noted - no per-tenant eviction histogram existed. Action: add eviction-by-tenant metric and create alert if eviction rate > 5% sustained for 5m. ETA: 2026-03-05.

2026-03-01 - Dev lead review: Decided split remediation approach: immediate (config tuning + alerting), near-term (bug fix to admission race), long-term (KV cache redesign for fairness + unit tests). Prioritization approved by Eng Manager.

2026-03-04 - Docs review (Marta, PM): Drafted three customer message tiers. Feedback: enterprise message must include timeline, mitigation steps, and direct escalation contacts. Action: include playbook entries for AM/CS handoff.

2026-03-08 - QA: Canary run results uploaded (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/actions/runs/14288). No regression visible on 48h canary after patch; performance metrics steady. Prepare for staged rollout.

2026-03-10 - Liam: Compiling final customer digest and internal action tracker; requesting comms sign-off from Head of Support and Legal by 2026-03-12. Next steps: schedule customer emails for impacted enterprise accounts on 2026-03-13 and public RCA on status page 2026-03-15.
